{ "rules": [
    "Model forecasts are consistently too low - true prices are higher than forecasts by ~0.2-0.5 on average",
    "Bias increases with forecast horizon - 30-day ahead forecasts show 0.3-0.5 dollar larger divergence than same-day ahead",
    "High sentiment (1.0) regions in forecasts are undershot by 0.3-0.6 compared to true prices",
    "Mean reversion bias: models maintain prices too close to current level, missing true price momentum",
    "When history shows upward trend, model lags behind true price by 0.2-0.4 dollars",
    "Sentiment positive (0.67-1.0) but history price flat requires 0.2-0.3 dollar forecast upward correction",
    "Model fails to capture price acceleration in later forecast horizons (days 15-30) where bias exceeds early horizons"
] }
